speaker: Sheldon
text: Leonard, excellent. I want to show you something. Just look. I've designed the perfect uniforms for our team. The colors are based on Star Trek, the original series. The three of you will wear support red, and I will wear command gold.

speaker: Leonard
text: In a way, I need to talk to you. Why do they say AA?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Army ants.

speaker: Leonard
text: Isn't that confusing? AA might mean something else to certain people.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Why would a physics bowl team be called anodized aluminum?

speaker: Leonard
text: No, I meant, Never mind. Check it out. I got you a Batman cookie jar.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, neat. What's the occasion?

speaker: Leonard
text: Well, you're a friend, and you like Batman and cookies, so you're off the team.

speaker: Sheldon
text: What?

speaker: Leonard
text: Howard, Raj, and I just had a team meeting. Yes, we did. I just came from there.

speaker: Sheldon
text: No, you didn't.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Okay, I don't know where you just came from, but it couldn't have been a team meeting, because I'm on the team, and I wasn't there. Ergo, the team did not meet.

speaker: Leonard
text: Okay, uh, let me try it this way. I was at a coffee clatch with a couple of friends, and one thing led to another, and it turns out you're off the team.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Why?

speaker: Leonard
text: Because you're taking all the fun out of it.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'm sorry. Is the winner of the physics bowl the team that has the most fun?

speaker: Leonard
text: Okay, let me try it this way. You're annoying, and no one wants to play with you anymore.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I see. Well, at this point, I should inform you that I intend to form my own team and destroy the molecular bonds that bind your very matter together and reduce the resulting particulate chaos to tears.

speaker: Leonard
text: Thanks for the heads up.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You're welcome. One more thing. It's on, Dick.
